metadata.title: NTS N° 123-MINSA/DIGEMID-V.01, Norma Técnica de Salud que regula las actividades de Farmacovigilancia y Tecnovigilancia (RM N° 539-2016/MINSA)
metadata.edition: Version 01 (2016) · day and month of the RM illegible in the scan · in force 60 calendar days after El Peruano publication: 26 September 2016 per a secondary note (not confirmed on an official host) · 6.7 and 6.10 (Spanish, OCR)
metadata.legal_basis: MINSA technical health standard under Ley 29459, DS 016-2011-SA and DS 013-2014-SA; the official text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
